paper_sections.title: Structural MRI processing and MEG coregistration
MEG preprocessing, time-frequency transformation, and sensor-level statistics

description.value: The study investigated age-related alterations in neural oscillatory dynamics during encoding, maintenance, and retrieval in a verbal working-memory task in 78 healthy aging adults using MEG and time-frequency-resolved beamforming.

value: Older adults would require stronger engagement of key left hemispheric frontal and parieto-occipital working-memory hubs.

Prefrontal activity lateralization during working-memory performance would diminish as a function of age, with older individuals tending to utilize a more bilaterally distributed working-memory network.

description.value: Single-group observational healthy-aging study with a cross-sectional age range; participants completed one MEG working-memory session and a structural MRI scan for coregistration.

description.value: MEG data were corrected for head motion and external noise, artifacts were removed, artifact-containing epochs were rejected, and data were transformed into the time-frequency domain and normalized to baseline power.

spans.text: MEG pre-processing and imaging used BESA (version 7.0) software.

value: external noise reduction using signal space separation with temporal extension
adaptive blink and cardiac artifact correction
artifact rejection by fixed thresholds and visual inspection

description.value: Participants encoded and maintained six consonant letters presented in a 3 × 2 grid, followed by retrieval of a probe consonant and a button-press response indicating whether the probe was in or out of the previous letter array.
A six-consonant array was presented for 2.0 seconds.
The letters disappeared and the empty grid remained for 3.0 seconds.
A single probe consonant was presented for 0.9 seconds and participants indicated whether it was present in the initial six-letter set.

instructions.value: Respond via button press with the right index or middle finger as to whether the probe was in or out of the previous array of letters.

stimuli.value: Consonant letters presented in a 3 × 2 grid.
